channel.title: a netcat's rambles
channel.description: Welcome traveller, to this little place in the ever-growing internet. This is a dumping place for topics that interest me, sidequests I've been on and a place for me to publish anything I make.

item.title: 100 Questions for Webmasters
item.description: I saw this on misaobit's website, and wanted to celebrate the reboot of my own website with a little infodump about myself.

item.title: The TF2 SDK is OPEN SOURCE
item.description: The Team Fortress 2 SDK has been released as open source software. This is a huge step for the modding community and the game itself, and we're going to take a look at what this means for the future of TF2.

item.title: Linux, Tech Giants, and the Death of Consumer Freedom
item.description: Microsoft finally broke me, so I decided to make the switch to Linux. In this post, I'll share my personal experience, my honest opinions, and a few words of caution for the Linux community.
